title: INFRAMIND: Infrastructure-Aware Multi-Agent Orchestration
title_zh: INFRAMIND：基础设施感知的多智能体编排
abstract_en: Existing multi-agent LLM orchestration methods, ranging from brute-force ensembles to learned routers, select models and topologies based on task and model features. However, these methods do not consider the runtime state of the serving infrastructure. On shared GPU clusters under concurrent load, this infrastructure blindness causes systematic resource underutilization: preferred models accumulate deep request queues while equally capable alternatives sit idle. In multi-agent pipelines, where each query triggers multiple sequential model calls, these delays then compound across every downstream step. Closing this gap is challenging because the relevant infrastructure signals (queue depths, KV-cache pressure, latencies) are dynamic and noisy, and they must drive three different decisions: planning, per-step routing, and scheduling. We introduce INFRAMIND, a framework that makes the entire multi-agent stack infrastructure-aware. An infra-aware planner conditions topology and role selection on real-time system load and remaining budget, biasing toward simpler graphs under congestion and richer ones at low load. An infra-aware executor then observes per-model queue depths, cache utilization, and response latencies at each agent step to decide which model to call and how deeply to reason; a budget-aware scheduler further reorders each model's queue so that urgent requests are served first. Cast as a hierarchical constrained MDP and solved end-to-end via reinforcement learning, the system learns to balance quality against latency automatically. Across five benchmarks, INFRAMIND delivers up to +7.6 pp accuracy over the prior baseline at low load with up to 7x lower latency, and sustains up to 99.9% SLO compliance under high load where every baseline drops below 50%.
abstract_zh: 现有多智能体 LLM 编排方法通常依据任务与模型特征选择模型和拓扑，但忽略了服务基础设施的实时状态。在共享 GPU 集群并发负载下，这种“基础设施盲性”会导致热门模型排队严重，而同等能力的替代模型空闲；在多智能体流水线中，单次查询会触发多个顺序模型调用，延迟会逐步累积。INFRAMIND 提出让整个多智能体栈具备基础设施感知能力：planner 根据实时系统负载与剩余预算选择拓扑和角色，在拥塞时偏向更简单的图结构、低负载时使用更丰富的协作；executor 在每个 agent 步骤观测模型队列深度、KV-cache 利用率和响应延迟，决定调用哪个模型以及推理深度；budget-aware scheduler 进一步重排各模型请求队列，优先服务紧急请求。作者将该问题建模为分层约束 MDP，并用强化学习端到端优化，使系统自动权衡质量与延迟。五个 benchmark 上，INFRAMIND 在低负载下相较既有 baseline 最高提升 +7.6 个百分点准确率，同时延迟最高降低 7 倍；高负载下可维持最高 99.9% SLO 合规率，而所有 baseline 均低于 50%。
key_points_zh: 问题切入：现有 multi-agent LLM orchestration 忽略共享 GPU 集群的实时队列、KV-cache 压力和延迟，导致资源利用不均与流水线延迟放大。
方法核心：INFRAMIND 将 planner、executor 和 scheduler 全部改造成 infrastructure-aware，覆盖拓扑规划、逐步模型路由和请求调度三个层面。
决策机制：infra-aware planner 在高负载下选择更轻量拓扑，在低负载下使用更复杂协作；executor 根据每步系统状态选择模型与推理深度。
优化框架：论文将系统建模为 hierarchical constrained MDP，并通过强化学习端到端学习质量、延迟与预算之间的权衡。
实验结果：在五个 benchmark 上，低负载下准确率最高提升 +7.6 pp、延迟最高降低 7x；高负载下最高保持 99.9% SLO compliance，显著优于 baseline。

llm_assessment.comment: Very strong production-oriented orchestration work that integrates infrastructure-aware planning, routing, scheduling, RL control, latency budgets, and SLO compliance.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作非常面向生产级智能体编排，结合了基础设施感知规划、路由、调度、强化学习控制、延迟预算和SLO保障。
